sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in strong form with seven wins from their last ten matches, and will be heavy favourites against bottom-placed Alsager, who have won just once all season and are on a run of five consecutive defeats.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their own recent loss and keep pace with leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, travel to Eccleshall in a fixture between two sides in mid-table contention. Wolverhampton Casuals, sitting fourth, visit Wednesfield Community on Saturday before facing Brereton Social in a midweek Wednesday fixture (7 October). Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a meeting of mid-table sides, while Barnton welcome Shawbury United; Shawbury are in desperate form with six consecutive losses. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a clash between struggling sides at the foot of the division, and Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a battle between teams fighting relegation concerns. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home on Saturday, both searching for consistency. Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday before their midweek trip to face Wolverhampton Casuals; Widnes remain pointless from their last five matches.
